author: Ari Koslow
title: Kel'el Ware not expected to be traded by Bucks
desc: The Bucks reportedly plan to keep Kel'el Ware.
impact: Ware figures to be center of the future for Milwaukee. He has drawn trade interest from several teams, including the Lakers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Herro expected to be kept by Bucks, but will field trade offers
desc: Milwaukee reportedly doesn't plan to move Tyler Herro but will field offers for him.
impact: Herro was the main part of the trade package the Bucks received for Giannis Antetokounmpo in Monday's blockbuster deal. This will remain a situation to monitor.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Alvarado moves decision date on player option to June 26
desc: Jose Alvarado agreed to move his $4.5 million player option from June 22 to June 26.
impact: The Knicks will get a chance to assess their trade options for picks No. 24 and 31 in this week's NBA Draft.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Darryn Peterson meets with Jazz over weekend
desc: Darryn Peterson told reporters  did meet with the Utah Jazz over this weekend.
impact: Peterson declined to say whether that was in-person. He said it was more of a Combine-like interview than an on-court workout. We will see where Peterson ends up on Tuesday.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Kasparas Jakucionis traded to Milwaukee Bucks
desc: Kasparas Jakucionis is being traded to the Milwaukee Bucks as part of the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade.
impact: Jakucionis will get a change of scenery after just one season in Miami, in which he averaged 6.2 points per game in 17.8 minutes per night. The 20-year-old, who was the 20th overall pick in the 2025 Draft, will get an opportunity to grow with a Bucks franchise that just traded away its franchise player.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Jaime Jaquez Jr. traded to Milwaukee Bucks
desc: Jaime Jaquez Jr. is being traded to the Milwaukee Bucks as part of the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade.
impact: Jaquez was part of what will likely be the biggest move of the offseason, and he now has a chance to grow into a bigger role in Milwaukee. While he will likely be behind Tyler Herro on the totem pole, the Bucks will be a team in need of offense next season. Jaquez averaged 15.4 points per game and was the runner-up for 6th Man of the Year voting last season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Bobby Portis Jr. traded to Miami Heat
desc: Bobby Portis Jr. is being traded to the Miami Heat as part of the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade.
impact: Portis is heading to South Beach as a member of what will likely be the biggest move of the offseason. The Heat gave up key rotation players in Tyler Herro, Kel'el Ware and Jaime Jaquez in the trade, so Portis should see plenty of playing time. However, with Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo in the front court, Portis' role will likley come off the bench.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Giannis Antetokounmpo traded to Miami Heat
desc: Giannis Antetokounmpo is being traded to the Miami Heat alongside Bobby Portis for Tyler Herro, Kel'el Ware, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kasparas Jakucionis, three first-round picks, one pick swap and one second-rounder.
impact: The biggest domino of the NBA offseason has fallen, as Antetokounmpo is heading to South Beach. The former MVP will join Bam Adebayo to create one of the most formidable frontcourts in the entire league. Antetokounmpo will immediately take over as the No. 1 option in Miami and should continue his elite-level production.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Ayo Dosunmu intends to sign 5-year, $112-million deal with Timberwolves
desc: Ayo Dosunmu intends to sign a 5-year, $112-million contract to return to the Minnesota Timberwolves.
impact: Dosunmu will have a player option in his fifth season, but he is now locked into Minnesota's corps for the near future. The guard is coming off a strong season where he averaged 14.8 points per game while shooting 43.9% from three-point land. He gives the Wolves a strong 3-and-D guard to pair with Anthony Edwards for years to come.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mouhamadou Gueye traded to Wolves, to be waived
desc: The Bulls have traded Mouhamadou Gueye to the Wolves, but he will be waived.
impact: This was part of the deal that sent Julius Randle to the Nets and Nic Claxton to the Bulls. Gueye will figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Nic Claxton traded to Chicago Bulls
desc: Nic Claxton is being traded to the Chicago Bulls in a three-team deal that includes Julius Randle heading to Brooklyn.
impact: Claxton will join the Bulls as a part of a trade that also includes the No. 28 overall pick heading to Brooklyn, and the Timberwolves receiving the No. 33 pick. Claxton averaged 11.7 points, 6.9 rebounds and 1.1 blocks per game with the Nets last season. The 27-year-old will bring a strong paint presence to a Bulls team that has needed one for a while.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Julius Randle being traded to Brooklyn Nets
desc: Julius Randle is being traded to the Brooklyn Nets in a three-team trade that sends Nic Claxton to the Chicago Bulls.
impact: Randle and the No. 28 pick in the NBA Draft are heading to Brooklyn, while the Timberwolves will acquire the No. 33 overall pick from the Nets. Randle averaged 21.1 points, 6.7 rebounds and five assists per game last season for Minnesota, which could be a team to watch going forward as a roster shakeup seems to be in the works.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Amen Thompson only 'near untouchable' player on Rockets roster
desc: Amen Thompson is reportedly the only "near untouchable" player on the Rockets' roster.
impact: Houston doesn't appear to be actively shopping other players, but they're open to doing so in the right offer. It doesn't appear any other star players are available as of now outside of Giannis Antetokounmpo -- who is expected to land with either the Celtics or Rockets.
